overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Constructed from elegant Canadian Red Cedar, this sauna features six strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, providing soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, it includes modern amenities like an interior touch screen control panel and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized experience. With its stylish bronze-tinted tempered glass door and chromotherapy lighting, the Maxxus sauna transforms any space into a luxurious escape.
